description.value:
Tier Novice

Check Perception vs. target's Deception DC

Effect success grants +1 circumstance bonus (Novice) to your next Deception check against them

Watch how a target performs for others before you approach — you'll know exactly which fake identity, sob story, or flattery already worked once.

cinderfall.incomplete: Self-facing but tracked per-specific-target, which needs a Hunt-Prey-style dedicated target-flagging apparatus (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/class-features/hunt-prey.json) to build correctly. Authoring a full target-tracking mechanism for one feat is disproportionate and out of this card's own scope.
